from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0105.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
# wide brown incl dark legs
wb=(R>45)&(R-B>20)&(G<R-8)&(B<120)&(R<200)
sub=wb[:,270:375]
ys,xs=np.nonzero(sub)
print('wide-brown u %d..%d v %d..%d'%(xs.min()+270,xs.max()+270,ys.min(),ys.max()))
print('per-col bottom:')
for u in range(272,375,6):
    c=np.nonzero(wb[:,u])[0]
    print('  u%3d'%u,'none' if not len(c) else 'top=%d bot=%d'%(c.min(),c.max()))
" 2>/dev/null
